es.title: Raúl Jardiel hace balance del Huesca y asegura que el equipo llega preparado al inicio de la temporada
es.description: La SD Huesca ha cerrado su fase de pretemporada y su entrenador, Raúl Jardiel, ha realizado un balance positivo sobre la preparación del conjunto oscense antes de iniciar la competición oficial en Primera Federación. El equipo altoaragonés debuta este sábado en el estadio de El Alcoraz ante el Sant Andreu, en un choque para el que el técnico considera que la plantilla está lista para competir. El preparador del cuadro azulgrana ha analizado el rendimiento físico y táctico en los ensayos estivales, donde el club ha firmado un balance oficial de cinco victorias, un empate y una derrota, sumando trece goles a favor y cuatro en contra. Respecto a la exigencia de las sesiones, Raúl Jardiel ha subrayado: "Hemos cargado muchísimo. La respuesta ha sido general positiva. Trato de relativizar mucho a nivel de resultados y a nivel de respuesta de equipo, pues bueno, soy consciente de que hay mucho trabajo por hacer, pero también creo y siento que llegamos preparados". El técnico zaragozano ha hecho hincapié en la dificultad y la importancia de ensamblar un plantel profundamente renovado, que cuenta con una veintena de incorporaciones para este curso. Jardiel ha insistido en que el trabajo estival se ha centrado en detectar conexiones entre futbolistas y encontrar el mejor encaje táctico para el grupo. En este sentido, Raúl Jardiel ha detallado la metodología aplicada durante estas semanas al señalar: "Lo que tenemos que hacer durante el año tiene que ver con sacar las virtudes y esconder los defectos. Evidentemente como entrenador puedes tener una idea de lo que quieres que sea el equipo, pero eso lo determinan los jugadores y sobre todo es eso lo que hacemos, tratar de ir viendo cómo se relacionan, qué sinergias tienen, quién caza mejor, quién caza peor, e ir puliendo sobre lo que vamos". El estreno liguero ante el Sant Andreu llega respaldado por una masa social que roza los 6.511 socios, lo que representa una fidelidad de entre el 90% y el 95% respecto a la campaña anterior. Con la plantilla pendiente de rematar sus últimos movimientos en el mercado, el Huesca afronta el inicio de la temporada con la meta de ser competitivo y asentarse desde la primera jornada en la zona alta de la tabla.

pt.title: Capelo e Nuninho fecham ciclo no Bragança com homenagem
pt.description: Capelo e Nuninho fecham ciclo no Bragança com homenagem FUTEBOL mdb Seg, 08/24/2026 - 15:05 O Grupo Desportivo de Bragança homenageou este domingo Fabien Capelo e Nuninho, dois jogadores que terminaram a carreira de futebolista após vários anos de ligação ao emblema brigantino. A homenagem decorreu antes do encontro da segunda jornada da Série 1 do Campeonato de Portugal, frente ao SC Braga B, com a Direção do clube a entregar aos antigos jogadores quadros representativos do percurso realizado e uma tarja que ficará na bancada do Estádio Municipal de Bragança junto dos adeptos. Fabien Capelo, que vestiu a camisola do GD Bragança durante 29 épocas, é o jogador mais utilizado da história do clube, com 396 jogos realizados. O antigo capitão terminou a carreira aos 36 anos e mostrou-se orgulhoso pelo reconhecimento.“Foi uma homenagem que o clube considerou que eu merecia. É sempre especial sentir o estádio cheio, ainda por cima na despedida. Os adeptos sabem que dei sempre tudo pelo clube e pela cidade”, afirmou. Entre as memórias do percurso, Capelo apontou a descida ao campeonato distrital, em 2021/2022, como o momento mais difícil, enquanto lembrou o jogo frente ao Braga, na Taça de Portugal da época passada, como um dos mais felizes. “O momento mais negativo foi quando descemos ao Distrital. Foi o momento em que mais me entristeceu no clube. O momento mais feliz foi na época passada, quando defrontámos o Braga para a Taça de Portugal, num jogo no qual a cidade se uniu toda em torno do clube.” Sobre um eventual regresso ao futebol, o antigo capitão não fecha a porta, embora não o perspetive para os próximos anos. “Durante dois ou três anos não posso pensar nisso porque não vou estar em Portugal, mas quem sabe no futuro. O Bragança sempre foi parte da minha vida e quando o clube precisar de mim — ou quando entender que é a altura de regressar — cá estarei.” Também Nuninho terminou a carreira aos 30 anos, após 23 épocas ligadas ao GD Bragança. “É sempre muito gratificante perceber o carinho que o clube e as pessoas têm por nós. Foi um momento que nunca vou esquecer e é um motivo de orgulho ter podido representar este clube durante tantos anos”, afirmou. O antigo jogador recordou a passagem pelos campeonatos distritais como o momento mais difícil do percurso e apontou a última temporada, com a qualificação para a fase de subida, entre as melhores experiências vividas no clube. “Pela negativa, foi a primeira vez que fomos ao Distrital. O clube estava numa fase mais complicada e foi o momento mais difícil que passei no clube. A época transata correu-nos muito bem e garantir a fase de subida foi inesquecível, tal como o primeiro golo pela equipa sénior.” A decisão de abandonar o futebol, explicou, resultou sobretudo de uma reflexão sobre o futuro e da necessidade de conciliar a vida desportiva com a familiar. “Foi uma decisão que me custou muito e que ainda me custa, mas tinha de ser tomada e acho que este ano seria o momento certo. Apesar de ainda me sentir capaz e ter todas as condições para continuar, senti que era a altura certa.” Para já, Nuninho pretende afastar-se do futebol, embora não descarte um eventual regresso em outras funções.“Agora quero desligar um pouco do futebol, mas no futuro, quem sabe.” O treinador do GD Bragança, André Irulegui, que orientou os dois jogadores nas últimas duas temporadas, considerou a homenagem plenamente justificada e frisou o profissionalismo demonstrado por ambos. “São dois jogadores que deixaram tudo em campo. Foram verdadeiros capitães de equipa.” Irulegui elogiou ainda como ambos encerraram o percurso no clube. “Invejo-os porque não tive a coragem que eles tiveram de acabar quando tinha de acabar. Deram tudo ao clube e despedem-se como campeões”, concluiu. Fotos: Guilherme Moutinho Guilherme Moutinho Edição 4103

Mężczyzna przyjął mandat w wysokości 1500 złotych i 13 punktów karnych, a także stracił uprawnienia do kierowania na najbliższe 3 miesiące. Natomiast w sobotę 22 sierpnia policjanci w miejscowości Jędrychowo z uwagi na przekroczenie prędkości zatrzymali do kontroli drogowej kierującą pojazdem marki Renault. sg.title: KSAT Opens Customer Demonstrations for HYPER Hybrid RF and Optical Relay Services
sg.description: Multiple customer demonstrations will validate hybrid RF and optical relay services ahead of commercial deployment. SALT LAKE CITY , Aug. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Kongsberg Satellite Services (KSAT) today announced the first demonstration campaigns for Hyperion, the pathfinder mission for HYPER, KSAT's next-generation hybrid radio frequency (RF) and optical relay network. The campaigns will validate the operational services planned for the commercial HYPER network through demonstrations with satellite operators, technology providers and institutional partners, marking the first opportunity for customers to test low-latency relay services before commercial operations begin. Hybrid Network Demonstrations The Hyperion satellites will carry multiple optical terminals from Rocket Lab, which acquired laser communications company Mynaric earlier this year, and Sony Space Communications Corp. (SSCC). The terminals will enable customer demonstrations of optical payload relay while supporting several optical inter-satellite communication links within the HYPER network. On the RF side, Hyperion will demonstrate S-band connectivity for telemetry, tracking and command, and Ka-band communications for payload data relay. Together, these demonstrations will validate how RF and optical links can work as complementary parts of a single relay network, supporting different operational requirements. The partnerships with Rocket Lab and Sony Space Communications Corp. mark an important step for the Hyperion mission and play a key role in the demonstrations. As the HYPER program progresses, KSAT welcomes collaboration with additional technology providers interested in contributing to the future hybrid relay network. "Hyperion is about proving operational services, not just technology. By bringing together customers, technology providers and institutional partners, we're demonstrating the hybrid RF and optical capabilities that will underpin the future HYPER network. These campaigns validate real operational use cases while laying the foundation for Europe's next-generation commercial satellite relay infrastructure," said Edvard Foss, vice president of HYPER at KSAT. Operational Validation Hyperion will validate multiple operational services planned for the HYPER network through dedicated demonstration campaigns with institutional and commercial partners. The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) will demonstrate operational communications services over HYPER, including bidirectional communications and payload data relay over Ka-band. These demonstrations will validate how HYPER supports rapid delivery of mission data through a single hybrid relay network. In parallel, HYPER is advancing through Phase 1 of the European Space Agency's European Resilience from Space (ERS) program to demonstrate relay-enabled real-time satellite tasking and high-throughput, low-latency downloads. About HYPER HYPER is KSAT's next-generation orbital data relay network. Using a hybrid RF and optical architecture, it delivers low-latency communications and payload data relay for satellites beyond the reach of traditional ground stations. About KSAT Kongsberg Satellite Services (KSAT) is a provider of ground network, Earth observation services, and satellite command and control. Headquartered in Tromsø, Norway, KSAT's U.S. subsidiary, KSAT Inc., is based in Denver. The company operates the world's largest commercial satellite ground station network, providing mission-critical infrastructure for the global space industry. About Rocket Lab Rocket Lab, which acquired laser communications leader Mynaric earlier this year, provides launch services, spacecraft, payloads and satellite components for commercial, government and national security customers. Its Electron rocket is the world's most frequently launched orbital small rocket. Its HASTE rocket provides hypersonic test launch capability for the U.S. government and allied nations. The company's Neutron launch vehicle, currently in development, is designed to support constellation deployment, national security missions and exploration. Rocket Lab spacecraft and satellite components have supported more than 1,700 missions, including GPS, constellation and lunar, Mars and Venus exploration missions. About Sony Space Communications Corp. Sony Space Communications Corp. (SSCC), established in 2022, is a subsidiary of Sony Corp. dedicated to developing and manufacturing optical communication terminals for satellite-to-ground and inter-satellite communications. The company aims to support the next generation of space-based communications infrastructure and expand access to global real-time connectivity. About NOAA The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration is a U.S. federal agency that provides science, services and environmental stewardship, including operating satellite systems for weather, climate and Earth observation. bd.title: KSAT Opens Customer Demonstrations for HYPER Hybrid RF and Optical Relay Services
bd.description: Multiple customer demonstrations will validate hybrid RF and optical relay services ahead of commercial deployment. SALT LAKE CITY , Aug. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Kongsberg Satellite Services (KSAT) today announced the first demonstration campaigns for Hyperion, the pathfinder mission for HYPER, KSAT's next-generation hybrid radio frequency (RF) and optical relay network. The campaigns will validate the operational services planned for the commercial HYPER network through demonstrations with satellite operators, technology providers and institutional partners, marking the first opportunity for customers to test low-latency relay services before commercial operations begin. Hybrid Network Demonstrations The Hyperion satellites will carry multiple optical terminals from Rocket Lab, which acquired laser communications company Mynaric earlier this year, and Sony Space Communications Corp. (SSCC). The terminals will enable customer demonstrations of optical payload relay while supporting several optical inter-satellite communication links within the HYPER network. On the RF side, Hyperion will demonstrate S-band connectivity for telemetry, tracking and command, and Ka-band communications for payload data relay. Together, these demonstrations will validate how RF and optical links can work as complementary parts of a single relay network, supporting different operational requirements. The partnerships with Rocket Lab and Sony Space Communications Corp. mark an important step for the Hyperion mission and play a key role in the demonstrations. As the HYPER program progresses, KSAT welcomes collaboration with additional technology providers interested in contributing to the future hybrid relay network. "Hyperion is about proving operational services, not just technology. By bringing together customers, technology providers and institutional partners, we're demonstrating the hybrid RF and optical capabilities that will underpin the future HYPER network. These campaigns validate real operational use cases while laying the foundation for Europe's next-generation commercial satellite relay infrastructure," said Edvard Foss, vice president of HYPER at KSAT. Operational Validation Hyperion will validate multiple operational services planned for the HYPER network through dedicated demonstration campaigns with institutional and commercial partners. The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) will demonstrate operational communications services over HYPER, including bidirectional communications and payload data relay over Ka-band. These demonstrations will validate how HYPER supports rapid delivery of mission data through a single hybrid relay network. In parallel, HYPER is advancing through Phase 1 of the European Space Agency's European Resilience from Space (ERS) program to demonstrate relay-enabled real-time satellite tasking and high-throughput, low-latency downloads. About HYPER HYPER is KSAT's next-generation orbital data relay network. Using a hybrid RF and optical architecture, it delivers low-latency communications and payload data relay for satellites beyond the reach of traditional ground stations. About KSAT Kongsberg Satellite Services (KSAT) is a provider of ground network, Earth observation services, and satellite command and control. Headquartered in Tromsø, Norway, KSAT's U.S. subsidiary, KSAT Inc., is based in Denver. The company operates the world's largest commercial satellite ground station network, providing mission-critical infrastructure for the global space industry. About Rocket Lab Rocket Lab, which acquired laser communications leader Mynaric earlier this year, provides launch services, spacecraft, payloads and satellite components for commercial, government and national security customers. Its Electron rocket is the world's most frequently launched orbital small rocket. Its HASTE rocket provides hypersonic test launch capability for the U.S. government and allied nations. The company's Neutron launch vehicle, currently in development, is designed to support constellation deployment, national security missions and exploration. Rocket Lab spacecraft and satellite components have supported more than 1,700 missions, including GPS, constellation and lunar, Mars and Venus exploration missions. About Sony Space Communications Corp. Sony Space Communications Corp. (SSCC), established in 2022, is a subsidiary of Sony Corp. dedicated to developing and manufacturing optical communication terminals for satellite-to-ground and inter-satellite communications. The company aims to support the next generation of space-based communications infrastructure and expand access to global real-time connectivity. About NOAA The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration is a U.S. federal agency that provides science, services and environmental stewardship, including operating satellite systems for weather, climate and Earth observation. pk.title: World: Protection Capacities Under Pressure: Mine Action Analytical Note | August 2026 - Human Cost of Funding Cuts
pk.description: Countries: World, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Mali, Niger, Nigeria Sources: Protection Cluster, UN High Commissioner for Refugees Please refer to the attached file. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY AND INTRODUCTION Between February and April 2026, the Global Protection Cluster investigated the impact of funding cuts on protection partners’ capacities. The findings presented in the report Protection Capacities Under Pressure synthesized 747 survey responses across 22 country operations. This analytical note focuses on the impact on Mine Action or activities aimed at mitigating the threat posed by mines and other explosive ordnance to communities in hazardous areas. It draws on the GPC capacity mapping and additional reports from UNMAS and the International Campaign to Ban Landmines and Cluster Munition Coalition. The most significant finding is not the scale of the funding cuts themselves, but the extent to which they have dismantled mine action capacity in communities that depend on it most. Of the 747 GPC survey responses, 144 (19%) reported direct impacts on mine action programming and activities, totaling 1,009 impact counts and average capacity losses of 29%.

SALT LAKE CITY , Aug. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Kongsberg Satellite Services (KSAT) today announced the first demonstration campaigns for Hyperion, the pathfinder mission for HYPER, KSAT's next-generation hybrid radio frequency (RF) and optical relay network. The campaigns will validate the operational services planned for the commercial HYPER network through demonstrations with satellite operators, technology providers and institutional partners, marking the first opportunity for customers to test low-latency relay services before commercial operations begin. Hybrid Network Demonstrations The Hyperion satellites will carry multiple optical terminals from Rocket Lab, which acquired laser communications company Mynaric earlier this year, and Sony Space Communications Corp. (SSCC). The terminals will enable customer demonstrations of optical payload relay while supporting several optical inter-satellite communication links within the HYPER network. On the RF side, Hyperion will demonstrate S-band connectivity for telemetry, tracking and command, and Ka-band communications for payload data relay. Together, these demonstrations will validate how RF and optical links can work as complementary parts of a single relay network, supporting different operational requirements. The partnerships with Rocket Lab and Sony Space Communications Corp. mark an important step for the Hyperion mission and play a key role in the demonstrations. As the HYPER program progresses, KSAT welcomes collaboration with additional technology providers interested in contributing to the future hybrid relay network. "Hyperion is about proving operational services, not just technology. By bringing together customers, technology providers and institutional partners, we're demonstrating the hybrid RF and optical capabilities that will underpin the future HYPER network. These campaigns validate real operational use cases while laying the foundation for Europe's next-generation commercial satellite relay infrastructure," said Edvard Foss, vice president of HYPER at KSAT. Operational Validation Hyperion will validate multiple operational services planned for the HYPER network through dedicated demonstration campaigns with institutional and commercial partners. The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) will demonstrate operational communications services over HYPER, including bidirectional communications and payload data relay over Ka-band. These demonstrations will validate how HYPER supports rapid delivery of mission data through a single hybrid relay network. In parallel, HYPER is advancing through Phase 1 of the European Space Agency's European Resilience from Space (ERS) program to demonstrate relay-enabled real-time satellite tasking and high-throughput, low-latency downloads. About HYPER HYPER is KSAT's next-generation orbital data relay network. Using a hybrid RF and optical architecture, it delivers low-latency communications and payload data relay for satellites beyond the reach of traditional ground stations. About KSAT Kongsberg Satellite Services (KSAT) is a provider of ground network, Earth observation services, and satellite command and control. Headquartered in Tromsø, Norway, KSAT's U.S. subsidiary, KSAT Inc., is based in Denver. The company operates the world's largest commercial satellite ground station network, providing mission-critical infrastructure for the global space industry. About Rocket Lab Rocket Lab, which acquired laser communications leader Mynaric earlier this year, provides launch services, spacecraft, payloads and satellite components for commercial, government and national security customers. Its Electron rocket is the world's most frequently launched orbital small rocket. Its HASTE rocket provides hypersonic test launch capability for the U.S. government and allied nations. The company's Neutron launch vehicle, currently in development, is designed to support constellation deployment, national security missions and exploration. Rocket Lab spacecraft and satellite components have supported more than 1,700 missions, including GPS, constellation and lunar, Mars and Venus exploration missions. About Sony Space Communications Corp. Sony Space Communications Corp. (SSCC), established in 2022, is a subsidiary of Sony Corp. dedicated to developing and manufacturing optical communication terminals for satellite-to-ground and inter-satellite communications. The company aims to support the next generation of space-based communications infrastructure and expand access to global real-time connectivity. About NOAA The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration is a U.S. federal agency that provides science, services and environmental stewardship, including operating satellite systems for weather, climate and Earth observation. pg.title: Telikom, Vodafone Sign Historic Network-Sharing Deal
pg.description: Telikom, Vodafone Sign Historic Network-Sharing Deal Telikom PNG and Vodafone PNG have signed a landmark Co-Location and Network-Sharing Agreement, allowing the two rival telecom operators to share towers, fibre and other network infrastructure instead of duplicating builds. Telikom CEO Amos Tepi called it a "historic first" for PNG's telecom industry, showing that competitors can cooperate for the country's benefit. A key part of the deal is a shift to a "bill and keep" interconnection model, meaning subscribers calling or texting between the two networks will no longer face interconnection charges. Mr Tepi thanked Vodafone for agreeing to this, saying it reflects the genuine partnership behind the agreement and should boost traffic between the networks. This builds on a 2022 interconnection deal that first let subscribers on both networks call and text each other. Infrastructure sharing is central to the agreement — rather than each company building separate towers in the same areas, they'll now use each other's existing infrastructure, cutting duplication and speeding up rollout. Mr Tepi acknowledged PNG's difficult terrain (mountains, islands, remote communities) makes connectivity hard, and said no single operator can solve this alone. Expected benefits include stronger signals, more reliable connections, faster infrastructure deployment, and freed-up investment redirected toward underserved wards and communities. Mr Tepi credited NICTA and the Government for promoting infrastructure sharing, and linked the deal to Telikom's transformation into a technology-driven company supporting PNG's digital economy, including work on digital public infrastructure with the ICT Department. Rollout will happen in phases, with technical teams assessing sites for integration. Mr Tepi thanked the engineers, lawyers and negotiators involved, noting it required patience and goodwill. The two companies will keep competing commercially while cooperating on infrastructure — a model Mr Tepi believes could redefine telecom competition in PNG, ultimately delivering lower costs and wider digital access nationwide.

ae.title: Gemini taps Apex to pipe crypto prediction markets into brokerages
ae.description: Monthly volume across Kalshi and Polymarket climbed from below $5 billion in September 2025 to almost $24 billion by April, Pew Research Center data shows. That trajectory is the backdrop to Gemini's newly signed letter of intent with Apex Fintech Solutions. On Monday, the crypto platform founded by billionaire twins Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss said it is teaming with Apex to distribute its regulated crypto prediction markets to brokerage firms. The agreement would make subsidiary Gemini Titan the exclusive regulated venue for crypto event contracts routed through Apex's futures commission merchant to its brokerage clients. A futures commission merchant, or FCM, is a regulated firm that manages customer orders and funds for futures and other derivatives trading. Execution and clearing would sit with Gemini. The plumbing is the point Consider what a brokerage gets out of it. As things stand, any retail brokerage that wants crypto event contracts on its menu has to wire up its own link to a prediction-market exchange — engineering hours, a compliance review, and an integration that needs ongoing upkeep. With this setup, brokerages already on Apex avoid every step of that. Venue, execution and clearing show up bundled together. Which makes this a distribution move rather than a product debut. Gemini isn't constructing a superior prediction market here. It's leasing out the one it operates to firms with no appetite for building their own. Two licenses, 4 months apart The regulatory scaffolding had to come first, and Gemini has assembled it step by step. In December 2025, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission granted Gemini Titan a Designated Contract Market license, allowing it to run a regulated derivatives exchange and offer prediction trading. Then in April, the CFTC awarded a Derivatives Clearing Organization license to subsidiary Gemini Olympus. That milestone carries more weight than the name suggests, because it allows Gemini to run clearing and settlement for Gemini Titan internally rather than depending on a third-party clearinghouse. Control the exchange, control the clearing, then line up a distribution partner. Apex is step three in a sequence rather than an isolated announcement. “We believe that predictions are the future of markets,” Gemini CEO Tyler Winklevoss said in the release. Why crypto firms keep landing here Event contracts allow users to bet on how real-world events turn out. As these contracts push deeper into mainstream trading, sports, politics and cryptocurrency have become the dominant categories. The heavy lifting — turning that concept into one of trading's fastest-growing niches — was done by Kalshi and Polymarket. What remains is what everyone else is now competing for. The reasoning is straightforward. Softer trading volumes have compressed revenue from conventional spot operations, pushing crypto firms toward prediction markets and other fresh products to broaden their income base. Fees from spot trading simply no longer cover it. Apex and Gemini already know each other The two companies aren't strangers. Back in July, Gemini rolled out commission-free stock trading for select U.S. customers, with Apex Clearing Corporation serving as custodian and clearing broker. They have therefore already taken an integration live together — a meaningful distinction from partnership news between firms that have never shipped a joint product. Still, expectations deserve calibrating. A letter of intent is not a signed contract. Both sides said they anticipate finalizing the details of the prediction-market collaboration within the coming weeks, meaning exclusivity, timing and economics remain unsettled. The Command Center layer May brought the debut of Command Center, an intelligence layer built for Gemini's prediction markets platform. It folds SpaceXAI models into the Gemini app to supply real-time market summaries, sentiment analysis and tailored signals derived from a user's portfolio and trading history. Set that beside the Apex agreement and the strategy comes into focus. Command Center serves as the retail-facing surface; Apex functions as the wholesale channel. One exchange underneath, two entirely different routes for bringing users to it. What to watch next One detail will reveal whether the plan works: which brokerages actually switch it on. Apex reaches brokerage customers, but a distribution deal only becomes volume once those firms conclude that crypto event contracts justify the compliance discussion with their own regulators. Keep an eye out for the first named brokerage going live on Gemini Titan via Apex. Short of that, this remains infrastructure waiting for a counterparty to plug in.

ويرتبط تحرك النادي التركي بالتغييرات المنتظرة في دفاعه في ظل احتمالية رحيل تشاغلار سويونجو وجايدن أوسترفولده إلى جانب سعي الإدارة للاستفادة من القواعد المحلية الخاصة بقيد اللاعبين الأجانب.

ويعرف أكتشيشيك أجواء فنربخشة جيدًا؛ إذ تدرج في صفوفه حتى وصل إلى الفريق الأول قبل أن ينتقل إلى الهلال الموسم الماضي مقابل 22 مليون يورو في صفقة جعلته رابع أغلى لاعب في تاريخ مبيعات النادي التركي.

ويمتلك المدافع الشاب قيمة سوقية تقدر بنحو 14 مليون يورو وفق التقييمات الحالية ليكون بذلك الأعلى قيمة سوقية بين مدافعي الهلال.

وبدأ أكتشيشيك مسيرته في أكاديمية جالطة سراي قبل أن ينتقل إلى قطاع الناشئين في فنربخشة عام 2019؛ حيث نجح في لفت الأنظار حتى حصل على فرصة الظهور مع الفريق الأول.

ولا تزال المفاوضات بين الهلال وفنربخشة في مرحلة الاستكشاف في انتظار تحديد صيغة الانتقال وإمكانية التوصل إلى اتفاق نهائي بشأن عودة اللاعب إلى النادي التركي.

sa.title: عاجل .. إيتو يساند إنفانتينو في ظل المطالبات باستقالته
sa.description:
أعرب النجم الكاميروني السابق صامويل إيتو الذي يشغل حاليا منصب رئيس اتحاد كرة القدم في بلاده، عن مساندته لرئيس الاتحاد الدولي للعبة (فيفا) جاني إنفانتينو الذي "لم يرتكب أي خطأ"، وذلك رغم الضغط الذي يواجه الإيطالي-السويسري على خلفية مشروع إدخال القطاع الخاص في مسابقاته والذي تخلى عنه لاحقا.

ويتعرض إنفانتينو لضغط كبير منذ انهيار مشروع كان يهدف إلى استقطاب استثمارات خاصة في بطولات فيفا، بما فيها كأس العالم.

وهدد الاتحاد الأوروبي لكرة القدم (ويفا) بمقاطعة مسابقات فيفا، فيما سحبت عدة اتحادات قارية ووطنية دعمها لإنفانتينو.

لكن إيتو رفض الانتقادات الموجهة إلى قيادة إنفانتينو، معتبرا أن هذه الحملة مدفوعة باعتبارات سياسية قبيل الانتخابات الرئاسية لفيفا المقررة العام المقبل.

وقال المهاجم السابق لبرشلونة الإسباني وإنتر الإيطالي وتشيلسي الإنجليزي لشبكة "سي أن أن" الأميركية "لا أعتقد أن الرئيس جاني إنفانتينو ارتكب أي خطأ أعتقد أن توقيت كل ذلك مرتبط بوجود انتخابات مقبلة".

وواجهت خطة إنفانتينو التي أفادت تقارير بأنها كانت ستوفر تمويلا كبيرا للاتحادات الأعضاء الـ211 في فيفا، معارضة قوية من عدة اتحادات قارية، قبل أن يتم التخلي عنها في نهاية المطاف.

ولا يزال رئيس فيفا يواجه ضغوطا، مع احتمال طرح تصويت على سحب الثقة منه.

وأعربت اتحادات أوروبا وآسيا وأميركا الشمالية والوسطى والكاريبي (كونكاكاف) عن مخاوفها بشأن توجهات فيفا خلال الأسابيع الأخيرة.
غير أن الاتحاد الإفريقي (كاف) أعاد في وقت سابق من الشهر الجاري "تأكيد الدعم بالإجماع" لإنفانتينو، ما يجعل موقف إيتو متماشيا مع هذا التوجه.

وقال إيتو "لقد غيّر الرئيس جاني إنفانتينو كرة القدم"، داعيا الدول الإفريقية الأخرى إلى دعم الإيطالي-السويسري، قبل أن يضيف "لقد منح فرصا لدول لم تكن تملك مثل هذه الفرص للمشاركة في أجمل بطولة في العالم، كأس العالم. كما أتاح للدول الأصغر الحصول على مقاعد في هذه المسابقات".

وتابع "ساعد قارتنا. ساعد اتحاداتنا على التطور بوتيرة أسرع بكثير، ويجب أن نعترف بذلك. علينا أن نتقبل وأن نُقر بما أنجزه، وينبغي أن ندعمه تقديرا لكل ما قدمه حتى الآن".

iq.title: "بيبسيكو" تتجه نحو العراق لتوسيع انتاجها بالشرق الأوسط
iq.description: شفق نيوز- ترجمة خاصة ذكر موقع "مستكشف الغذاء" (Food Navigator) البريطاني، أن دور العراق كمركز اقليمي لتصنيع "شركة بيبسيكو" يتزايد، حيث انه برغم الاضطرابات المستمرة في الشرق الاوسط، فان الشركة تضاعف توسيع انتاجها الإقليمي. واوضح الموقع البريطاني المتخصص بالشؤون الغذائية، في تقرير له ترجمته وكالة شفق نيوز، انه برغم هيمنة اخبار الحرب في ايران طوال العام 2026، الا انه في ظل عدم وجود نهاية للصراع في الافق، فان الحياة والاعمال تتواصل بشكل اعتيادي في أجزاء اخرى من المنطقة. وتناول الموقع في تقرير له العراق كمثال على ذلك، واصفا اياه بانه كان مركزا قديما للاخبار المرتبطة بالنزاعات طوال العقد الاول من القرن الـ21، وانه برغم موقعه القريب من مركز الحرب في ايران، إلا ان هذا البلد يظهر كمركز تصنيع جديد محتمل، ويحظى بالاهتمام حتى من الماركات التجارية الكبرى مثل "بيبسيكو". ولفت التقرير الى مزايا العراق الواضحة كجغرافيته والعدد الكبير من الشباب وارتفاع الوصول الى المكونات الغذائية المنتجة محليا بحسب منظمة "الفاو" ما يشمل العديد من المحاصيل الاساسية وكذلك التمور والفواكه والطماطم والبطاطا والبروتين الحيواني. ونقل التقرير عن الرئيس التنفيذي للشركة في الشرق الاوسط وشمال أفريقيا وباكستان احمد الشيخ قوله انه خلال قمة الاعمال الامريكية –العراقية مؤخرا، انه "بصفتنا واحدة من المراكز الزراعية التاريخية في المنطقة، نريد دعم القدرات الزراعية للعراق وقدرته الصناعية لتصبح مركزا للصادرات الغذائية". وتابع الشيخ قائلا بحسب التقرير، ان هناك فرصة "لاستكشاف امكانية تنمية قطاع تصنيع الاغذية في العراق وتعزيز القطاع الزراعي في البلد، مع البدء بتصنيع الأغذية القوي"، مضيفا "نأمل في خلق فرص تفيد المزارعين والصناعة المحلية مع دعم المنتجات المصنوعة بفخر في العراق". وبحسب التقرير البريطاني فان هذا لا يمثل المشروع الوحيد للشركة في العراق خلال العام الحالي، حيث وقعت الشركة ايضا مذكرة تفاهم مع شركة بغداد للمشروبات الغازية (BSDC) وذلك بهدف تعزيز الطاقة الانتاجية المحلية لتجاوز 250 مليون منتج سنويا. ولفت التقرير الى ان "بيبسيكو" تعتمد على شراكة قائمة منذ العام 1984. ونقل التقرير عن بيان للشركة قولها ان "مذكرة التفاهم هذه تعكس ثقة شركة بيبسيكو في المستقبل الصناعي للعراق، وتدعم التوظيف والتصنيع المحلي". ونقل التقرير عن محمد شلباية، وهو الرئيس التنفيذي لشركة الشرق الاوسط وافريقيا للمشروبات محمد شلباية، قوله ان الشركة تعتبر العراق لاعبا رئيسيا في تصنيع المشروبات في المنطقة، موضحا ان الطموح المشترك يتضمن استكشاف الفرص المحتملة المتعلقة بتوسيع الطاقة التصنيعية، وتعزيز دور العراق كمركز رائد لانتاج المشروبات في الشرق الاوسط". لكن التقرير لفت الى تحديات عدة تواجه العراق فيما يتعلق بالتصنيع، من بينها مرافق التخزين الباردة، واستقرار الامدادات الكهربائية، بالاضافة إلى لوجستيات النقل والتوقيتات.
